DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/browser-ex.description:
Deletes the browser extension configuration for an account.
The shard mapping is preserved and not deleted.

400.description: Invalid request body or account ID.

403.description: The authenticated user is not authorized to access this account, the Browser Extension service is not enabled for this account, or service availability could not be verified for this account.

503.description: Browser Extension service availability could not be verified.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/browser-exten.description: Returns the browser extension configuration for an account.

team_domain.description: Team domain for the browser extension.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the configuration was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last configuration update.

403.description: The authenticated user is not authorized to access this account, the Browser Extension service is not enabled for this account, or service availability could not be verified for this account.

503.description: Browser Extension service availability could not be verified.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/browser-exte.description: Creates the browser extension configuration for an account.

team_name.description: Access team name. The service derives `team_domain` as `<team_name>.cloudflareaccess.com`.

team_domain.description: Team domain for the browser extension.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the configuration was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last configuration update.

400.description: Invalid request body or account ID.

403.description: The authenticated user is not authorized to access this account, the Browser Extension service is not enabled for this account, or service availability could not be verified for this account.

409.description: Configuration already exists for this account.

503.description: Browser Extension service availability could not be verified.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/browser-exte.description:
Searches browser extension event logs for an account. The request accepts
only supported fields and filters; raw SQL is not accepted.

200.description: Browser extension event log search response.

400.description: Invalid request body or account ID.

403.description: The authenticated user is not authorized to access this account, the Browser Extension service is not enabled for this account, or service availability could not be verified for this account.

413.description: Invalid request body or account ID.

PUT /accounts/{account_id}/browser-exten.description:
Replaces the browser extension configuration for an account.
The configuration must already exist. The shard mapping is immutable.

team_name.description: Access team name. The service derives `team_domain` as `<team_name>.cloudflareaccess.com`.

team_domain.description: Team domain for the browser extension.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the configuration was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last configuration update.

400.description: Invalid request body or account ID.

403.description: The authenticated user is not authorized to access this account, the Browser Extension service is not enabled for this account, or service availability could not be verified for this account.

503.description: Browser Extension service availability could not be verified.
